news.headline: Jio Platforms IPO: How Reliance, Meta, Google and other investors’ stakes will change post the offer
news.summary: Jio Platforms’ Rs 30,213 crore IPO will dilute the percentage stakes of existing investors, including Reliance Industries, Meta and Google, while leaving their share counts unchanged. At the upper end of the price band, Jio is expected to be valued at Rs 10.3 lakh crore, more than double the valuation at which most investors entered in 2020.

news.headline: IDBI Bank shares fall 7% as investors book profit after Fairfax deal gets cabinet nod
news.summary: IDBI Bank shares plunged as investors booked profits after a nearly 13% rally in the previous session following the Cabinet’s approval of Fairfax’s acquisition of a 60.72% stake in the lender. The stock had hit Rs 93.60 on Wednesday, lifting its market capitalisation above Rs 1 lakh crore. The Rs 52,878 crore deal marks a major step in IDBI Bank’s long-awaited privatisation, with Fairfax’s bid of Rs 81 per share exceeding the independent valuers’ average fair value of Rs 75.99.

news.headline: Marine Drive was lit up for Reliance IPO: Uday Kotak recalls Dhirubhai Ambani’s market legacy amid Jio IPO
news.summary: Jio's upcoming IPO will surpass previous records, signaling a remarkable development in Reliance Industries' history. Uday Kotak reflects on the past influence of Dhirubhai Ambani's public offerings from decades ago. The offering will represent a crucial advancement in India's digital transformation and consumer access to data. Reliance's focus is shifting towards digital services and new-age business models as it continues to dominate the market.

news.headline: Reliance Industries shares rise 3% as Jio sets price band for possibly biggest-ever issue. What shareholders must know
news.summary: Shares of Reliance Industries rose 3% after Jio Platforms announced its IPO, comprising 27 crore new shares anticipated to garner Rs 30,213 crore. With 35% of shares earmarked for retail investors and a cut-off date of October 14 for current shareholders, Jio Platforms is primed to enhance its foothold in the consumer tech and digital infrastructure sectors.

news.headline: Nilesh Shah on PSU privatisation: How Hindustan Zinc offers a lesson for IDBI Bank
news.summary: Kotak AMC’s Nilesh Shah cited Hindustan Zinc as an example of how strategic divestment combined with a retained minority stake can create long-term national wealth. He said the government’s remaining stake is now worth over Rs 62,000 crore and expressed hope that IDBI Bank’s divestment would deliver similar value.

news.headline: Torrent Power plans around $500 million bond sale, bankers say
news.summary: Torrent Power is set to launch a substantial bond sale of rupee-denominated bonds, aiming to raise around $500 million. This comes after their earlier issuance of 38 billion rupees. The company's initiative to diversify funding sources includes discussions with potential investors. The funds will be directed towards the acquisition of Nabha Power for approximately 69 billion rupees, reflecting a growing trend of companies exploring funding avenues beyond traditional banks.

news.headline: Indian bonds breathe easy as Treasury yields decline
news.summary: Early Thursday, bonds issued by the Indian government saw slight upswings, influenced by a rally in US Treasuries. Despite this, concerns over liquidity, climbing interest rates, and mounting supply challenges have capped these hikes. Traders are curbing risk levels prior to a major debt auction, while rising domestic inflation fuels anticipations of a tougher monetary approach from the Reserve Bank of India, as evidenced by the expanding India-U.S. yield spread.

news.headline: From Rs 1,000 in 1977 to Rs 52 lakh today: The Reliance wealth story behind Jio’s Rs 10.3 lakh crore valuation in mega IPO
news.summary: A Rs 1,000 investment in Reliance Industries’ 1977 IPO could be worth nearly Rs 52 lakh today, including shares received through the Jio Financial Services demerger. As Jio Platforms prepares for its Rs 30,200 crore IPO at a Rs 10.3 lakh crore valuation, investors will assess its growth prospects and pricing.

news.headline: Global Market: Bank of China (Hong Kong) plans $3.3 billion onshore yuan debt issuance
news.summary: Bank of China (Hong Kong) plans to issue up to 22.2 billion yuan in onshore negotiable certificates of deposit in 2026, strengthening funding access and financial integration. The move supports Hong Kong’s ambition to become a leading offshore yuan hub, promoting cross-border investment and expanding the Chinese currency’s international role.

news.headline: Indian Bank, UCO Bank lead Q2 profit growth as treasury income slumps
news.summary: Indian Bank, UCO Bank, South Indian Bank and Karur Vysya Bank reported double-digit Q2 profit growth, supported by core income and loan expansion. However, rising bond yields hurt treasury earnings, while improving asset quality and provisions shaped quarterly performance.

news.headline: Paras Healthcare fixes IPO price band at Rs 660-693; issue opens on Oct 21
news.summary: Paras Healthcare has set its IPO price band at Rs 660-693 per share, targeting Rs 1,450 crore. Opening October 21, the issue will fund debt repayment and corporate needs, supporting expansion across its hospital network in India.

news.headline: Tech Mahindra announces 1:1 bonus issue, Rs 15 interim dividend; check record date
news.summary: Tech Mahindra announced a 1:1 bonus share issue and Rs 15 interim dividend as it celebrated its 40th anniversary. The company expects bonus shares to be credited by December 15, 2026, subject to approvals, with October 23 as dividend record date.

news.headline: Jio Platforms IPO | Akash and Isha Ambani speak at Jio Press Conference
Jio IPO: Akash Ambani says Rs 30,213 crore issue will push company towards net debt-free status
news.summary: Jio Platforms plans to use IPO proceeds of up to Rs 27,500 crore to repay borrowings and move towards net debt-free status. Akash Ambani also highlighted opportunities in India's projected $1.4 trillion digital economy by FY31.

news.headline: How Akash, Isha Ambani’s missed college assignment led to the creation of Rs 10 lakh crore Jio
news.summary: A failed college assignment by Isha Ambani helped spark the idea for Jio, which is now preparing for a Rs 30,213 crore IPO at a valuation of around Rs 10.3 lakh crore. Akash Ambani said the proceeds would go towards debt reduction, as Reliance seeks to unlock value from its digital business.
